name: xor_decode_words_backward
description: Walks a buffer of 16-bit words from its end toward its start, XOR-combining each word with the word after it and a fixed key. The pass count comes from the length argument, halved and reduced by two.

name: xor_fold_words_forward
description: Walks a buffer of 16-bit words forward, replacing each word with the XOR of itself, the following word and a fixed key. The pass count comes from the length argument, halved and reduced by two.

name: call_routine_five_times
description: Calls the same unnamed routine five times in a row and then returns. It is one of the steps run by the buffer preparation routine.

name: call_twice_if_flag_set
description: Always invokes one routine, then invokes it a second time only when a global flag word is nonzero. The flag is written by the argument validation code in the same file.

name: close_library_and_return
description: Makes a single call to the library-closing wrapper and returns to its caller.

name: validate_path_argument_option
description: Checks a command-line path argument. An argument starting with an at-sign sets a global flag when the next character is S or s; other arguments are accepted only if they contain a slash or colon separator, and otherwise the routine returns failure.

name: call_shared_routine_once
description: Makes a single call to a shared routine and returns, doing no other work of its own.

name: copy_quoted_or_space_token
description: Copies one token from a source string into a destination buffer. A leading double quote makes the token end at the next quote, otherwise it ends at a space or line end, and the copy is zero-terminated.

name: find_delimiter_pair_or_stop
description: Scans a string for a specific delimiter character followed by one of two marker characters. It returns zero when that pattern is found and minus one if either of two stop characters appears first.

name: return_failure_with_stack_value
description: Returns a 64-bit result whose upper half is minus one and whose lower half is the first stack argument. It serves as a failure return for its callers.

name: scan_for_marker_or_stop
description: Scans forward through a string for either of two marker characters, returning zero on the first match. It returns minus one if one of two stop characters appears first.

name: read_whole_file_by_size
description: Gets a file's size by locking and examining it, then reopens the file and reads its contents into a buffer sized from that length. It closes the file and returns the buffer address and byte count.

name: write_buffer_to_file
description: Opens a file through the dos library, writes the given buffer to it, and closes the file. It returns zero when the open succeeded and minus one when it failed.

name: write_zero_terminated_text
description: Advances to the end of a zero-terminated text string and then calls the dos write routine. It returns its two incoming register values unchanged.

name: open_dos_library_and_streams
description: Opens the dos library and fetches its standard input and output handles. It returns zero when all three succeeded and one otherwise.

name: allocate_into_free_slot
description: Finds an empty slot in a fixed table of pointer pairs, records a requested size in it, and asks the exec library to allocate memory. The address is stored in the slot, or the stored size is cleared when allocation fails.

name: free_allocated_slot_list
description: Walks a linked list of allocated blocks held in a global table, freeing each block through the exec library until a null link is reached.

name: build_sorted_directory_index
description: Opens the dos library and walks a directory listing, collecting entry names and sorting them with an exchange sort. It then builds a table in which each name is paired with a packed four-character key.

name: build_name_record_table
description: Walks a list of zero-terminated names, case-insensitively matches each against a reference name, and writes fixed-size records of copied names and running counters into a table. Path names with a particular prefix get a numbered digit written into them.

name: stub_single_instruction_handler
description: The facts report a single instruction reached only through a handler pointer, so no behaviour can be recovered from it. The attached decompiler output is longer than that and was not used.

name: stub_single_instruction_handler
description: The facts report a single instruction reached only through a handler pointer, so no behaviour can be recovered from it. The attached decompiler output is longer than that and was not used.

name: open_read_close_file_chunk
description: Opens a file through the dos library, reads from it and closes it, and it is called from the buffer preparation routine. The attached decompiler output does not match these facts and was not used for the wording.

name: stub_single_instruction_handler
description: The facts report a single instruction reached only through a handler pointer, so no behaviour can be recovered from it. The attached decompiler output is longer than that and was not used.

name: stub_single_instruction_handler
description: The facts report a single instruction reached only through a handler pointer, so no behaviour can be recovered from it. The attached decompiler output is longer than that and was not used.

name: start_and_wait_for_messages
description: Program entry point that finds its own task, waits on a message port and retrieves messages from it. The title text it references describes a level handler and an AGA chipset check.

name: take_over_display_load_data
description: Takes over the display by disabling interrupts, owning the blitter and loading an empty view, then programs the DMA control and copper registers. It loads the data files named in its text references through the dos library.

name: handle_key_into_text_buffer
description: Clears a flag, then examines a key code passed in a register. The escape code returns at once, while any other nonzero code shifts a 16-byte text buffer and stores the character at its end.

name: clear_word_table
description: Clears thirty-two consecutive 16-bit words in memory to zero and returns.

name: classify_control_character
description: Examines a character code passed in a register. A space or newline sets a four-byte marker and a counter, and the control codes 28 to 31 each set a state byte and clear a flag.

name: find_matching_string_entry
description: Walks a table of zero-terminated names, comparing each with a buffer. On a match it stores the entry's associated value, and it returns early when the table ends or the match is marked as failed.

name: forward_to_shared_routine
description: Makes one call to a shared routine and returns, doing no other work of its own. It is entered from outside the normal flow, through a handler pointer.

name: clear_flag_and_call_pointer
description: Calls one routine, clears a global word, calls another routine, and then calls through a stored function pointer. It is a short dispatch step reached through a handler pointer.

name: initialize_game_state_and_display
description: Initialises working variables and copies two tables into place, clears further blocks of memory, and sets the video and DMA state. It makes about twelve calls to other unnamed routines during this setup.

name: derive_default_totals_record
description: Fills three default values in a small record when they are zero, derives a total from them and stores a value about two-thirds of that total. It then writes a block of four fixed-size entries using a pair of constants.

name: write_separator_and_pair
description: Writes a fixed separator character and then two stored bytes into the output buffer, making several calls to other routines as it goes.

name: sort_records_by_key
description: Builds a table of records from two arrays and sorts them with an exchange sort. Records are compared on several 16-bit and 32-bit key fields in turn, and a whole record is swapped when it is out of order.

name: format_five_digit_decimal
description: Converts a number up to 99999 into decimal digits in a text buffer. A zero value is written as a single zero, and otherwise leading zeros are suppressed.

name: format_four_digit_decimal
description: Writes a value into a text buffer as four decimal digits, capping it at 9999 and padding with zeros.

name: copy_indexed_twelve_byte_entry
description: Copies a twelve-byte entry from a table, selected by an index, into two destination areas of six bytes each.

name: verify_display_configuration
description: Compares a set of stored register values against expected constants and returns zero only when they all match. When a flag is clear it first copies a table of words into a buffer.

name: shift_buffer_past_ampersand
description: When the first byte of a fixed-size text buffer is an ampersand, the routine shifts the buffer left by one byte and terminates it. The same test and shift are repeated twice in a row.

name: reset_audio_and_display_state
description: Clears several blocks of game variables and then resets the hardware for sound and display. It sets the four audio channel volumes, the collision control and the copper and DMA control registers, and makes thirteen calls to other unnamed routines.

name: write_newline_to_two_buffers
description: Writes a line-feed character into two output buffers, making calls to other routines before each write.

name: build_symbol_lookup_table
description: Builds a table of 16-bit symbol values from a list, subtracting a fixed offset from each and ending the table with a sentinel value. When a flag is set it also fills a second table.

name: skip_computed_count_strings
description: Advances a pointer past a computed number of zero-terminated strings, counting down one string at a time. The count comes from two stored values multiplied together and shifted.

name: skip_strings_by_table_index
description: Advances a pointer past a number of zero-terminated strings, with the count taken from a stored index multiplied by another stored value. The new pointer is left for the caller.

name: update_fire_button_palette
description: Writes three palette colour values to fixed hardware addresses, choosing between two sets according to the fire-button state read from the CIA port register. It then increments a frame counter and sets status bits from a second counter.

name: reset_game_variables_block
description: Clears two counters and a block of sixty-four words of game variables, copies one stored value into another, calls another routine and then clears a further flag.

name: wait_for_fire_button_state
description: Repeatedly calls four routines and polls the fire-button and direction bits of the input port, returning once the button state changes as expected.

name: wait_for_input_port_match
description: Repeatedly calls three routines and reads two state bits of the input port until their combination matches the expected pattern, then returns.

name: compute_screen_offsets_from_value
description: Derives several screen position values from one input by replicating its low nibble and adding fixed offsets. The results are stored into display variables.

name: draw_image_records_from_list
description: Waits for the blitter, then walks a list of image records and draws each one into the display buffer. Each record's fill pattern is chosen by comparing its colour byte with a running value.

name: track_stick_position_while_held
description: Starts a position value from an input and loops while the input port reports the controls as held, nudging the value up or down according to the directional bits it reads. It returns the position shifted left by nine bits.

name: fill_copper_pattern_table
description: Fills a table of 127 entries with a repeating pattern, placing a special entry at one index. It then sets bits in a computed hardware control word.

name: process_object_list_frame
description: Processes the per-frame object list by checking a pending flag and walking the entries to compare positions and velocity values, calling eleven routines to act on the results. It reads the joystick and mouse button registers along the way.

name: dispatch_table_entry_by_type
description: Dispatches on a type code stored in a record. Some type codes store a value directly into a global table, one calls further routines, and the remaining codes fall through to the default branch.

name: spin_until_counter_wraps
description: Increments a byte in a loop until it wraps to zero and the low bit is clear. It spins as a timing delay reached through a handler pointer.

name: spin_until_counter_wraps
description: Increments a byte in a loop until it wraps to zero and the low bit is clear. It spins as a timing delay reached through a handler pointer.

name: spin_until_counter_wraps
description: Increments a byte in a loop until it wraps to zero and the low bit is clear. It spins as a timing delay, with its own loop structure and no return value.

name: wait_for_matching_counter_value
description: Spins until a stored byte matches the value passed in the data register, then continues while its low bit is set. The facts show it reads the raster position register, so it waits on the video beam position.

name: spin_until_byte_nonzero
description: Spins while a stored byte is zero, then repeats while its low bit is clear. It is a timing wait reached through a handler pointer.

name: wait_byte_match_on_beam
description: Spins until a stored byte matches the value passed in a register, with a second wait when a high flag bit is set. The facts show the wait also reads the raster position register.

name: run_frame_loop_mouse_buttons
description: Runs the frame loop by calling a sequence of routines on each pass. It clears two per-frame counters when their flags are set, reads the right and middle mouse buttons, and steps through a ring of values into two variables while setting the background colour.

name: clear_conditional_word_blocks
description: Clears one of two blocks of 22 words depending on two flag tests, setting a sentinel in one slot. In one branch it also calls another routine.

name: update_animation_countdown_state
description: Counts down an animation timer and reloads it from one of a few values when it expires, updating a state byte along the way. When a stored word changes it also clears a block of data.

name: init_object_record_fields
description: Initialises an object record by storing the register arguments into its fields. It sets a default when a looked-up count is zero, computes a pointer into a table of 24-byte entries, and waits for the blitter.

name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Makes two calls to other routines in sequence and returns.

name: test_bounding_box_overlap
description: Checks whether a record's coordinates overlap a bounding box with a margin of seven units. When they do, it advances an index and sets a record field, and it returns through a shared pointer.

name: decode_keyboard_serial_input
description: Reads a keyboard code from the CIA serial register and converts it to a letter. The P and S keys toggle the pause and sound flags, other letters set cursor and command state, and the escape code sets a flag.

name: draw_sprite_row_blitter
description: Counts down two timers and, when they expire, selects a source image address and starts a blitter copy of it into the display. It waits for the blitter to finish before setting its registers, then calls another routine.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return, so there is no behaviour to recover from it.

name: clamp_sprite_position
description: Clamps two position values to a screen range and updates counters that step them. It sets pairs of sprite coordinates from fixed values depending on whether each position is within range.

name: compute_clipped_sprite_coordinates
description: Scales two coordinates by a factor, clamps them to a fixed limit and sets their low bits. It then selects on-screen position values and writes the resulting coordinates into a record.

name: process_active_entry_list
description: Walks a table of ten three-word entries and, for each active entry, calls two routines. An entry marked with the terminator value ends the walk early.

name: adjust_field_when_in_bounds
description: Checks whether one rectangle lies within a bounds range and, if so, subtracts a stored amount from a 32-bit field of the second record. Otherwise it leaves the record unchanged.

name: add_field_when_in_bounds
description: Applies the same bounds test as its neighbouring routine and adds a stored amount to the 32-bit field when the test passes.

name: advance_sprite_animation_frames
description: Walks ten animation records, decrementing each countdown and advancing its frame when it reaches zero. Records whose cell is blocked are reset, and expiring records look up their next frame from a table.

name: stub_single_instruction_handler
description: The facts report a single instruction reached only through a handler pointer, so no behaviour can be recovered from it. The attached decompiler output is longer than that and was not used.

name: stub_single_instruction_handler
description: The facts report a single instruction reached only through a handler pointer, so no behaviour can be recovered from it. The attached decompiler output is longer than that and was not used.

name: stub_single_instruction_handler
description: The facts report a single instruction reached only through a handler pointer, so no behaviour can be recovered from it. The attached decompiler output is longer than that and was not used.

name: stub_fallthrough_handler
description: The facts report four instructions that fall through into the routine after it, reached only through a handler pointer. The attached decompiler output shows a longer routine and was not used for the wording.

name: program_blitter_copy_registers
description: Advances a frame counter, then programs the blitter's source, destination, modulus and size registers for a copy, polling the blitter status before the operation starts.

name: fill_sprite_record_from_table
description: Looks up two values by index in a table and writes them into a sprite record as adjusted coordinates, with a fixed offset applied. It also stores two scaled values taken from a second table.

name: fill_sprite_record_if_valid
description: Looks up coordinate values for an index and writes them into a record when the index is in range, returning zero. For an out-of-range index it clears the record and returns minus one.

name: process_pending_draw_requests
description: Walks a list of pending draw requests, calling ten routines to handle each one. It returns a pointer to the request it finished with.

name: apply_motion_transform_by_type
description: Adjusts a pair of coordinate values according to a type byte. Type three shifts the flag bits, type two adds a scaled offset, type one negates both values and sets a timer, and other types divide both values by four.

name: step_positions_within_limits
description: Steps two position values by fixed increments while they remain under their limits, decreasing a timer on each step. When the mode byte is two it repeats the stepping for a second pair of values.

name: set_field_if_mode_two
description: When a mode byte equals two it sets a field to fifteen. It then calls another routine and returns.

name: scan_until_test_passes
description: Loops over a set of entries, calling a test routine for each, and returns as soon as the test reports a hit. It advances a packed offset by a fixed step on each pass.

name: draw_sprite_list_blitter
description: Walks a list of sprite entries until a zero entry, filling each one's position and blitter values and waiting for the blitter before drawing. It returns when the list is exhausted.

name: clip_and_place_sprite_entry
description: Updates a sprite's position from its stored velocity, clamps it at the screen edges and then places it. It waits for the blitter before the placement.

name: clamp_bounds_on_flag
description: When a flag is set and a coordinate is negative, computes a clamped position from two limits, stores it into the output pair, and clears the source entry.

name: subtract_stored_deltas_if_clear
description: Subtracts stored position deltas from two offset pairs when their enable flags are clear, and preserves saved values across the call. It returns with the saved state restored.

name: lookup_distance_falloff
description: Computes a squared distance between a point and a stored reference, takes a value from a lookup table when the distance is small enough, and returns a scaled result. When the table value passes a threshold it reduces a stored total.

name: copy_and_mirror_row_pairs
description: Copies source words into two destination buffers and writes a derived value, shifted and offset, alongside each copy. It repeats for a fixed count.

name: select_position_and_write_glyphs
description: Chooses one of several screen positions by comparing a stored coordinate against thresholds, then writes a sequence of character codes and attribute bytes into a buffer.

name: reset_audio_channels_and_dma
description: Clears the audio channel state, selects volumes from two flags, and writes the DMA control value to enable the channels. It spins on a counter before the final write.

name: fetch_next_audio_entry
description: Reads the next three-word entry from a sound list, stores its fields and advances the list pointer. When the list is empty it returns a default length of two.

name: bounce_on_wall_contact
description: Checks two objects against boundary tests and, when a contact code matches one of a set of values, reverses the vertical or horizontal velocity. It sets a timer or pointer instead when the bounce is disabled.

name: update_collision_counters_by_type
description: Swaps two saved coordinate pairs, then checks an object type code and, for matching types, adds fixed increments to a score or stat and updates a stored state. It calls another routine to test the contact.

name: compute_tile_cell_mask
description: Computes the address of a tile cell from a row and column index, reads two words from it and combines them into a mask. It derives a shift count from the column remainder for use before a blit of the cell.

name: scroll_viewport_by_steps
description: Moves a horizontal scroll position by fixed steps when a flag is set, then takes the next display column from a stored value and calls routines to draw it.

name: build_draw_request_for_object
description: Fills a draw request for an object record when it is visible, storing its position and fixed blit values. It checks a column boundary before storing the result.

name: init_blit_record_defaults
description: Stores a position and a fixed set of blit values into a record, setting two of its fields to thirty-six, and returns the value passed in.

name: init_blit_record_with_mask
description: Stores a position combined with a fixed mask and several blit values into a record, setting two of its fields to thirty-six, and returns the value passed in.

name: blit_entry_list_to_display
description: Walks a list of ten image entries and, for each one that has a value, programs the blitter's source, destination and size registers to copy it. It waits for the blitter before each copy.

name: start_blit_request
description: Waits until the blitter is free, then fills a blit request record with a control word, source and destination pointers and a size from its arguments.

name: blit_second_entry_list
description: Walks a list of image entries one per pass and, for those without a value, programs the blitter to copy them into the display. It uses a different fixed size value from its neighbouring routine.

name: clamp_scaled_table_offset
description: Computes a value from a table entry and two inputs, scales it by sixteen, clamps it to a fixed range and adds the offset passed in.

name: update_positions_and_run_routines
description: Updates two position values from stored inputs when their flags are clear, then calls ten routines in turn.

name: try_advance_object_position
description: Checks whether an object is clear of a bound and has room to move, then advances its position by three and calls another routine. It returns one unless that routine reports success.

name: try_advance_second_object
description: Performs the same position check and advance as its neighbouring routine, using the second object's fields.

name: process_pending_action_flags
description: Handles pending action flags: when a flag is set it clears it and calls routines to attempt the action. It then decrements a counter, stopping at zero.

name: apply_collision_velocity_damping
description: When an object is marked as hit, reduces its counter by four and shrinks its velocity components by one eighth. It applies the same change to the second object.

name: process_player_input_frame
description: Reads the fire button and direction state each frame, updates the player's velocity and fire state, and calls routines to move and act on them. The fire button state comes from the CIA port register.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return, so there is no behaviour to recover from it.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return, so there is no behaviour to recover from it.

name: pack_input_bits_into_byte
description: Packs bits from an input word into a state byte, using the low two bits for the first two inputs and setting higher bits from the fire state. When a flag is clear it also sets a further bit from a fire-button test.

name: unpack_input_state_word
description: Unpacks a state byte into an input word, setting bits for the first two inputs and for the matching fire state. It clears two state flags when a pointer passes its limit.

name: read_mouse_and_joystick_ports
description: Reads the mouse and joystick port movement registers, converts the movement into direction values, and updates the fire and position state. It calls three routines along the way.

name: load_file_size_and_contents
description: Locks and examines a named file to get its size, then reopens it and reads the data into a buffer, closing the file afterwards. It also sets the background colour register while it runs.

name: store_palette_colour_entry
description: Stores a 12-bit colour value and derives two further colour entries from it by shifting and masking. It sets a flag when the high bit of the input is set.

name: allocate_tracked_memory_block
description: Finds a free entry in a table of tracked memory blocks, records a requested size there and asks the exec library to allocate memory. The address is stored in the entry, or the size is cleared when allocation fails, and it loops forever if the table is full.

name: free_all_tracked_blocks
description: Walks the table of tracked memory blocks and frees each block through the exec library, skipping entries that are already empty.

name: free_tracked_block_by_key
description: Searches the tracked memory table for a given key, marks the matching entry as released and frees its block through the exec library.

name: stub_return_only
description: Contains only a return, so there is no behaviour to recover from it.

name: restore_system_state_on_exit
description: Restores the system before exit by waiting briefly, unloading the loaded segment, closing the libraries, re-enabling interrupts and disowning the blitter and view. It waits for the blitter first.

name: forbid_and_reply_message
description: When a flag is set, it forbids task switching and replies to a message, then returns zero.

name: interpolate_line_points
description: Computes midpoint coordinates for a pair of points and steps through interpolated positions between them for drawing.

name: set_clip_bounds_and_draw
description: Sets a clipping rectangle expanded by four units beyond the given corners, then draws the requested shape within it, calling two routines to do the work.

name: draw_three_pass_layers
description: Runs a drawing routine over three layers, stepping the buffer pointer by a fixed amount after each pass, and repeats until a counter wraps to zero.

name: draw_four_pass_layers
description: Runs the same pass loop as its neighbouring routine, but over four layers, stepping the buffer pointer by a fixed amount each time.

name: start_blitter_copy_operation
description: Works out a blitter source offset from two coordinates, waits for the blitter, then writes the modulus, pointer, first-word mask and size registers and starts the operation.

name: draw_blitter_line_octant
description: Computes the absolute differences between two points and selects one of eight line directions from them. It then programs the blitter's line registers, waiting for the blitter first.

name: format_numbered_label
description: Builds a text label by placing a digit character first and then a source string, and copies the finished label into a destination buffer.

name: draw_menu_entries_with_input
description: Copies a text label into a buffer, then loops over a set of entries, drawing each one by repeated calls to drawing routines. It reads the fire button state on each pass.

name: decode_keyboard_key_to_char
description: Reads a keycode from the keyboard serial register and maps it through a symbol table to a character. A repeat counter counts down between presses.

name: update_state_for_type_codes
description: Stores a value into state bytes for three type codes and returns true for two of them, and for the third only under a condition.

name: forward_to_single_routine
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns, with a few unreachable branches removed by the decompiler.

name: render_text_string_glyphs
description: Walks a zero-terminated text string and renders each character as a glyph, computing its screen position from the running coordinates and the glyph width. When the string ends it calls an optional completion routine and returns.

name: blit_masked_image_region
description: Computes blit parameters for an image region from a set of offsets, programs the blitter's source, mask, destination and size registers, and calls routines to finish each row. It waits for the blitter before starting.

name: scan_text_for_control_code
description: Scans a text string for a single special character, mapping characters through a six-entry substitution table. It stops at a line end or at a control character.

name: clamp_input_position_on_fire
description: Checks the fire and direction bits of the input port and, when a movement is blocked, sets a limit value of 199. It then sets bits in a status word depending on a computed position.

name: tick_frame_counter_and_toggle
description: Increments a frame byte and counts down a timer. Every ten frames the timer reloads and two stored colour words are XORed with a mask to flip them.

name: absolute_product_swapped_halves
description: Takes the absolute values of two inputs, multiplies the high word of one by the low word of the other, and returns the product with the second input's halves swapped.

name: check_horizontal_window_draw
description: Checks whether a horizontal distance lies within a window running from just below zero to 106 units. Inside the window it calls four routines, and outside it clears two entries.

name: check_vertical_window_draw
description: Applies the same window test as its neighbouring routine on the other axis. Inside the window it calls several routines, and outside it clears an entry and stores a fixed value.

name: build_address_table_entries
description: Fills a five-entry table with addresses spaced 10752 bytes apart, then fills a block of entries starting from 384 and copies each to a companion word.

name: build_row_address_table
description: Fills a three-entry table with addresses spaced 42 bytes apart, then fills a block of words starting from 386 and copies each to a companion word.

name: initialize_sprite_position_table
description: Stores a sequence of preset coordinate pairs into a table and then copies entries in a loop over the whole table.

name: compute_row_address_pair
description: Clamps a row index between fixed bounds and computes two addresses for that row. It stores them into a record along with addresses one row further along.

name: pack_tile_attribute_word
description: Packs a row, a column and flag bits into a 32-bit attribute word, adding a fixed offset and an extra bit when a special condition holds, then stores it.

name: pack_tile_attribute_pair
description: Packs a 16-bit value and a flag into a 32-bit attribute word with a fixed offset, using a second offset when a special condition holds.

name: select_source_by_slot
description: Picks one of several source values by comparing the target address against a set of slots, then copies the chosen value into a register and calls a routine.

name: clear_fifteen_long_words
description: Clears fifteen consecutive 32-bit entries starting after the address passed in.

name: store_masked_port_bits
description: Masks a status word with a fixed bit pattern and stores the result in a global variable for later use by the input code.

name: decode_joystick_direction_bits
description: Decodes direction bits read from the two joystick ports into direction flags, cancelling out opposing directions.

name: stub_single_instruction_handler
description: The facts report a single instruction reached only through a handler pointer, so no behaviour can be recovered from it. The attached decompiler output is longer than that and was not used.

name: blit_sprite_frame_at_position
description: Computes a clipped sprite position from a stored origin, waits for the blitter and programs its registers to draw the frame in a single blit operation.

name: load_level_graphics_and_enable
description: Stores two file-name pointers from its argument block, then takes over the blitter and sets the DMA and background colour registers. It copies the file name into a buffer for loading.

name: compute_line_slope_octant
description: Works out which octant a line from one point to another lies in, using the signs and relative sizes of the two offsets. It then looks up a slope value from a table.

name: process_timed_entry_list
description: Walks a list of twelve-byte entries, skipping empty ones, and for each active entry checks a flag pair before calling a routine. It stops early when a button is held or the list ends.

name: insert_entry_into_free_slot
description: Scans a table of 16-bit entries, remembering the first empty slot, and stores a new entry into the appropriate position.

name: test_bitmap_cell_occupied
description: Computes a byte address and bit within a bitmap from a position, and checks that cell and two neighbouring bytes for a set bit. It returns without storing a result.

name: find_matching_entry_position
description: Computes two candidate positions from table lookups and walks a linked list looking for an entry that matches them, returning the match.

name: setup_gf2_assign_and_copy
description: Program entry for the path setup tool. It reads its command-line argument, then runs the assign and copy steps that set up the GF2 directory; the text it references holds those commands and a startup file name.

name: write_file_returning_status
description: Opens a file through the dos library and, when it opened, writes the buffer and closes the file, returning one. It returns zero when the file could not be opened.

name: write_string_to_output
description: Measures a zero-terminated string and writes it to the output handle through the dos library, returning its two register inputs unchanged.

name: open_console_window_for_output
description: Opens the dos library and then a console window named by its text, keeping the handle for output. It returns zero on success and one on failure.

name: close_console_and_library
description: Closes the console handle if it was opened, then closes the dos library.

name: fill_globals_with_constant
description: Writes a single register value into a long list of global variables in one pass and returns.

name: start_spec_report_and_log
description: Program entry point that sets up working values and calls ten routines in sequence, with the log file name among its text references.

name: format_report_field_values
description: Formats a set of computed values into a report buffer through several calls, each one writing a field of the report.

name: format_percentage_gain_text
description: Formats a percentage figure as two decimal digits and writes it into a text buffer, but only when a file signature check passes.

name: print_separator_line_with_flags
description: Writes a line made of two dashes and a bracketed label through a stored output routine, adding a flag digit for each of two optional settings.

name: write_times_phrase_text
description: Writes a short phrase ending in 'times.' into a text buffer through a stored output routine.

name: format_elapsed_time_text
description: Converts a frame count, taken at fifty frames per second, into hours and minutes text with singular or plural wording.

name: format_unsigned_decimal_text
description: Writes an unsigned number as decimal digits into a text buffer, using a descending series of place values and an optional leading character.

name: clear_record_and_mark_end
description: Clears a 120-byte buffer and writes a terminator value into a word that the record refers to.

name: write_checksum_tag_into_header
description: Sums a sequence of values and stores the negated total, XORed with a fixed tag, into a header word.

name: xor_decode_words_via_pointer
description: Like its neighbouring routine, walks a buffer of 16-bit words backward from an end pointer, XOR-folding each word with the next one and a fixed key. The buffer address comes from a pointer argument.

name: xor_fold_words_via_pointer
description: Walks a buffer of 16-bit words forward from a pointer argument, replacing each word with the XOR of itself, the following word and a fixed key. The pass count comes from the length argument.

name: find_or_add_table_key
description: Searches a table of keyed records for a given value and, if no record matches, appends a new record and increments the count. The key is stored in the record found or added.

name: stub_single_instruction_handler
description: The facts report a single instruction reached only through a handler pointer, so no behaviour can be recovered from it. The attached decompiler output is longer than that and was not used.

name: blit_bitmap_with_edge_masks
description: Blits a bitmap region with first and last word masks, computing the source and destination offsets from its arguments and calling routines to write each row. Its blitter setup includes the modulus and size registers.

name: copy_rows_with_stride
description: Copies a block of words row by row from one buffer into another, moves the pointers back by a fixed stride, and copies a second block.

name: wait_for_blitter_idle
description: Spins while the blitter busy bit of the DMA status register is set, then returns.

name: decode_packed_bitplane_rows
description: Checks a two-byte BP signature and, when it matches, decodes run-length packed bytes into a buffer, repeating each run of values as the header describes.

name: fill_block_with_byte
description: Fills a block of memory with a repeated byte value, aligning the start to a four-byte boundary first and then writing four bytes at a time.

name: write_log_file_or_flash
description: Opens the log file through the dos library. If the open fails it repeatedly sets the background colour as a visible failure signal, otherwise it writes the record and closes the file.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:0000
name: start_lha_program_setup
description: Program entry point of the LhA archiver: it opens the arp and dos libraries, allocates working memory, and sets the task priority and signal state before running the command. The text it references names the LhA options and the libraries.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:01A4
name: release_lha_resources
description: Restores the task priority, closes the libraries and frees the working memory before returning the result.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:0750
name: process_pending_archive_entries
description: Walks a linked list of archive entries and calls a routine for each one. When that routine reports failure, five further routines are called.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:07CE
name: copy_entry_name_by_mode
description: Copies an entry's name into a buffer, taking either a stored name or the path depending on a mode value, and returns a status value.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:07FC
name: start_path_with_separator
description: Clears a path buffer and appends a directory separator, unless a stored value says the path is already built, in which case it calls another routine.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:080E
name: append_path_separator
description: Moves to the end of a path string and appends a directory separator followed by a terminator.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:0826
name: copy_stored_path_string
description: Copies a zero-terminated string from a field of a record into the destination buffer, including its terminator.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:099E
name: prompt_overwrite_choice
description: Checks a stored overwrite flag, then unless it is set reads one-letter answers: A for always, N for no, Q for quit, S for skip and Y for yes. It updates the flag or result to match.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:1140
name: is_whitespace_character
description: Returns one when a character is a space, tab, line feed or carriage return, and zero otherwise.

key: worms - xtra (1996)(various)[h rippa - internet][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Xtra (1996)(Various)[h Rippa - Internet][addon levels][WB].adf:lha:0:11E4
name: parse_lha_command_line_options
description: Parses the LhA command line and its environment options, handling quoted strings, include files and illegal command messages. It reads the arguments through the dos library.
